recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-31419; future narrower terminology guidance should come from a new Patient Care decision or profile-specific constraints.
issue_request: FHIR-31419 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request for R5 asking that Procedure.statusReason's example Procedure Not Performed Reason (SNOMED-CT) value set include SNOMED CT qualifier value 410536001 Contraindicated instead of relying only on highly precoordinated procedure/situation codes.
initial_application: The Jira comment pointed to commit 4490a6918cfe685fc75111dc2151b312fd5fe386, which added 410536001 to source/procedure/valueset-procedure-not-performed-reason.xml and to tools/tx/snomed/snomed.xml. Current source retains that addition.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists procedure=Procedure, and Procedure.statusReason still binds with example strength to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/procedure-not-performed-reason. Later same-artifact Jira FHIR-47822 was resolved no-change because the binding is example strength and can be narrowed in profiles/IGs; older FHIR-14869 used the same rationale.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change was needed because the authoritative value set source already includes 410536001 and the target element still references that value set.

related_jiras.note: Later R6 ballot challenge to the same Procedure.statusReason value set was resolved no-change because the binding is example strength.
Earlier STU3 concern that Procedure.statusReason used the wrong value set was resolved no-change based on the statusReason comment and example binding.
